verdict.rationale: The evidence shows admin-side policy controls (retention settings, org-wide recording/access policies) and user-side recording controls, but nothing describing participant-facing consent mechanisms such as in-meeting recording disclosure banners, automated participant notifications when a bot joins, or admin-enforced transparency toward attendees. Notably, Fellow explicitly supports recording 'without a visible bot' by capturing desktop audio directly, which underscores the absence of a documented notification/disclosure mechanism rather than confirming one.
